name: Switching Technologies Gunther Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Switching Technologies Gunther Ltd does manufacturing and trading of Switching Products  in SEZ (MEPZ)[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company manufactures miniature reed switches with technology supplied by a collaborator. These are used in various applications as a control device, in the aircraft industry, power electronics, telecommunications, industrial control equipment and automobile electronics. Ccompany is developing SMD Reed switches and CRR Sensors as an extension of reed switches

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -9.97% over past five years.
